notes: SR131 OTTO Home (otto.de), scoped to Wohnen (Home/Living) department. EXCLUDED /wohnen/inspiration/?reduziert (title 'Guenstige Wohn-Ausstattung online kaufen » Bis zu 30% Rabatt | OTTO', data-pagecluster=Einstiegsseite i.e. a landing/inspiration page not a real PLP -- no product-count element found on the page). EXCLUDED /outlet/ (falls back to OTTO's generic unscoped search-fallback template, title 'Gefunden auf Otto.de', noindex -- confirms no dedicated Outlet section exists anywhere on the site). FOUND and INCLUDED 'Restposten' (= brief's explicit target term, remaining/discontinued stock) as a genuine, distinctly SEO-branded, indexed PLP: own page title/og:title literally 'Restposten' (or 'Restposten <Department>'), canonical to itself, robots index,follow, at the Wohnen department root and 3 of the 4 in-scope sub-departments (Moebel/Furniture, Dekoration/Decor, Lampen/Lighting). The 4th sub-department, Heimtextilien (Home Textiles), returned OTTO's generic noindex fallback template with no product-count element for the same rabatt=_restposten filter -- treated as a zero/no-genuine-listing result and dropped per the zero-product rule. Scope note flagged on the Wohnen-root row: the 3 verified sub-department Restposten counts sum to 37,189, well short of the Wohnen-root figure of 150,356 -- each number is independently and exactly sourced from that URL's own reptile-item-count data-item-count attribute (not estimated), but the exact composition of the Wohnen-root figure beyond the 3 checked sub-departments (e.g. Bad/Garten-relevant items, Haushalt-adjacent tableware/glassware nodes noted in the prior Home-Decor pass) is not independently confirmed, hence the flag rather than silent inclusion or exclusion.
